recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should treat FHIR-17623 as historical support for component stratifiers and FHIR-34896 as the controlling later decision for MeasureReport.group.stratifier.code cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-17623 was a Published FHIR-core/CQI change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested component-based stratifiers so measures could stratify by multiple dimensions, such as age group and sex, without artificially concatenating criteria values.
initial_application: Jira points to GH#422102297f; git commit 422102297fc7daa54eb3a94c39d56f71e1e9fa63, followed by ac358312458b32e583a3f83588386715d749674f, added component-based stratifiers to the Measure and MeasureReport spreadsheet sources before the current StructureDefinition XML refactor.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active build resources. Current Measure source retains repeatable Measure.group.stratifier.component with component code, description, and criteria descendants, and current MeasureReport source retains repeatable MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.component with required code and value[x]. The clinical reasoning quality-reporting narrative explains component stratifiers using the age-range/gender use case. Later FHIR-34896 intentionally corrected MeasureReport.group.stratifier.code to 0..1, so that current cardinality should not be restored to the older FHIR-17623 text.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already conveys the requested component-stratifier capability.

related_jiras.note: Corrected MeasureReport.group.stratifier.code from 0..* to 0..1, explaining the current intentional difference from the original FHIR-17623 wording.
